title: UneceReferencePrice
description: A reference to a sum of money for which something is or may be bought or sold.

basisQuantity.description: A quantity on which the reference price is based.

chargeAmount.description: The monetary value of a charged reference price.

comparisonMethodCode.description: The code specifying the comparison method for this reference price.

netPriceIndicator.description: An indication of whether or not the reference price is a net price.
